roleTitle: Technical Program Manager, Identity Provider Service
jobDescription: The identity provider service signs in every user of the company's products and is the dependency every other team fears breaking. The Technical Program Manager runs changes into that production service: the staged production rollout of each change across the regions, the launch readiness review before the rollout starts, the rollout watch with the identity SRE team and the halt or rollback when sign-in error rates move, and the launch record afterwards. Reports to the head of identity platform; works with the identity engineering teams, identity SRE, the regional operations leads and the product teams that depend on sign-in.
requirements: Has run staged production rollouts of identity service changes across the regions.
Runs the launch readiness review before each rollout and holds the rollout schedule.
Watches each rollout with identity SRE and halts or rolls back when sign-in error rates move.
Plans each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams.
Writes the launch record with the residual risks and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.
Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.

Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign-in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.
Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.
Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand-over conditions for the regional operations leads.
Work sample: the rollout tickets for the last quarter, the readiness review minutes for the same changes and the launch records for the four halted rollouts and the rollback.

Recruiter screen: asked about the rollback, the candidate described the sign-in error rate movement, the halt, the rollback decision with identity SRE and the launch record; the account agrees with the resume and the rollout ticket.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of identity platform asks that the packet cite the rollout tickets and the launch records, and keep any pre-production rehearsal work separate from the production rollouts.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the production rollouts, the readiness reviews, the halts and rollback, and the launch records.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The production rollouts, the rollout watch and the halts are documented in the resume and the rollout tickets; keep the environment and the counts as stated.
